title: ISCB UK 2027: Biology in the Age of AI
level: Researchers and students (open call for abstracts)
about: ISCB UK 2027: Biology in the Age of AI takes place 20 to 22 April 2027 at the University of Strathclyde, Glasgow. Abstracts are due 16 February 2027, with notifications on 9 March 2027; late-breaking posters close 22 March 2027.

upskill.name: the AI Foundations Academy

A001.21 is not on the shortlist (below course_min_score) and the top-scoring shortlist courses match only on the words "age" and "AI", so the post links to the Academy page, not a specific course
